body.objective: Derive the generic local symbol and first three parameter variations of the correctly normalized longitudinal Schur operator, providing a clean local input and negative controls for the pseudodifferential/heat-kernel math request.
body.stop_condition: Starting from S_L(t)=(2/3)I+(1/3)delta(F+tW)^(-1)d on a common primed domain, derive the exact resolvent expansion through t^3 with all operator ordering, adjoints and projector derivatives explicit.  Compute the principal and subprincipal symbol orders of each variation and prove that the first correction is order -2; separate local symbol/residue data from finite smoothing/global trace data.  Specialize the first variation to the scalar-flat Berger low block and reproduce -64/81, then provide a flat or commuting control and a deliberate one-inverse-surrogate mutation that the verifier rejects.  Export canonical operator-word and symbol manifests consumable by sf:forge-request/pseudodifferential-heat-kernel-symbol-calculus.  If projector/domain variation introduces an unprovided term, certify that precise nondefinition rather than freezing the projector silently.
body.current_gate: correct normalized-Schur local variation and symbol-order theorem
body.forbid: no commuting reordering of noncommuting resolvents and insertions; no frozen primed projector without a stated hypothesis; no local Wodzicki residue called a finite determinant; no scalar surrogate; no Euclidean-local result promoted to QME, Lorentzian or particle evidence
activates: a verified local operator input for the M30 pseudodifferential/heat-kernel layer
negative controls preventing recurrence of the incorrect scalar surrogate
body.resource_hint: LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/EUCLIDEAN-SPECTRAL.  This can proceed in parallel conceptually with the global block work, but the resident one-lease policy means pull the queue order chosen by s-f.
notes: This does not compete with the global Berger measure: it establishes exactly which pieces are local and which remain genuinely spectral.
